# Native cursor contract capture

This is a historical capture. The current gate and publisher use
[`current-contracts`](../current-contracts); see the [consumer guide](../../README.md).

These artifacts were emitted when native cursor identity was published, from the
commit and with the command recorded in [provenance.json](provenance.json). That
command no longer exists, and nothing regenerates or updates this directory. The
artifacts include the form controller and the optional React/Vue adapter modules
that the generated client has since removed; they are kept byte for byte as the
record of that publication, not as current output.
